prompt: A warm kitchen doorway viewed straight on, with three small wooden chef stations arranged in a gentle row in the foreground. Each station has a simple white chef hat resting on it and one distinct tool: the left station holds a handwritten notepad and pencil suggesting thoughtful contemplation (the craving station); the middle station holds a small pile of blank labeled cards and a quill (the labels station); the right station holds a polished wooden serving spoon and ladle (the food station). Each station feels distinct but part of a family. Soft amber light spills through the doorway behind them. Editorial illustration style, cozy and considered, honey and cream palette, hand-drawn textured feel, negative space.
